## The problem

What are you trying to do that liustack/quickjs makes hard or impossible today?

## Proposed change

What you would like it to do.

## Scope check

liustack/quickjs is a pure Go JavaScript engine for Go programs, kept for rendering React on the server ([tifa](https://github.com/liustack/tifa)). It is an engine, not Node: no `require`, `fs` or `process`, and the host gives a script what it needs through the Go API. Does this request fit that? If it widens it, say why it belongs here.

## Alternatives

Anything you have tried or considered (a Go function given to the VM, a polyfill, a workaround).
